Can't help with this one. Aim assist (aimbot) and a radar overlay for ranked VALORANT are cheats that directly harm real players competing in good faith — that puts it in a different category from single-player trainers or offline mods.

If you want to work on game systems in a context that isn't actively ruining other people's ranked games — like building your own shooter, writing a legit aim trainer tool, or exploring game networking concepts — I'm happy to dig into any of that.
